mapper.sql: is_deleted=false AND (email ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR nickname ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')AND status=#{status}
mapper.select: SELECT id::text AS id,email,nickname,role,status,email_verified,credit_balance,created_at,last_login_at FROM users WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
